name: T dock trigger content (File menu trigger)
do: eval:(()=>{const box=document.querySelector("main .dock-trigger.dock-dropdown-trigger");if(!box)return 'none';const R=box.getBoundingClientRect();const out=[];for(const e of box.querySelectorAll('*')){const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();if(!r.width)continue;const o=Math.max(R.left-r.left,r.right-R.right);if(o>1){const cs=getComputedStyle(e);out.push({el:e.tagName.toLowerCase()+'.'+[...e.classList].slice(0,3).join('.'),o:Math.round(o*10)/10,w:Math.round(r.width*10)/10,tr:cs.transform==='none'?cs.translate:cs.transform.slice(0,40),ws:cs.whiteSpace,pos:cs.position})}}return {boxW:Math.round(R.width),n:out.length,top:out.slice(0,6)}})()

name: T tabs variant items under a long label
do: eval:(()=>{const e=document.querySelectorAll(".story-variant-items [role=tab]")[0];if(!e)return 'none';const w=document.createTreeWalker(e,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);let t,best=null;while((t=w.nextNode()))if(t.textContent.trim().length>1&&(!best||t.textContent.length>best.textContent.length))best=t;if(best)best.textContent="Quarterly enrollment by district and program, all years";return 'ok'})()
